children: Pictet Asset Management SA disclosed a 5.04% stake in Dynatrace, Inc., managed on behalf of its institutional clients. The firm filed a Schedule 13D on Sep. 16, 2026, detailing recent trades through mid-September. The move highlights Pictet’s active engagement approach with Dynatrace on strategy, governance, and sustainability.

Pictet Asset Management SA says it holds Dynatrace shares as part of a strategy that weighs long-term strategy clarity, strong governance, fair valuation, and material sustainability risks and opportunities. The firm states it is "actively engaging with the Issuer to discuss and promote initiatives that align with these business practices."

Pictet does not plan to seek control of Dynatrace and has no current proposals that would change control. It notes it "reserves the right to change its intentions" as it continues its engagement and assessment of the company’s policies and practices.

Pictet Asset Management SA is a Switzerland-based investment adviser and part of the Pictet Group, serving institutional clients worldwide. The firm focuses on active management with an emphasis on quality, long-term growth, and sustainability factors. Pictet has a history of engaging portfolio companies on governance and strategic priorities to support long-term value.
